item.title: About
item.description:
This site is a personal space where I document what I’m learning.

I come from a backend engineering background and am currently exploring algorithms and machine learning.

Most posts here are notes or reflections written while trying to understand things more clearly. I write mainly to organize my thoughts and keep track of my learning process.

English is not my first language. Writing here is also a way for me to practice thinking and expressing ideas in English.
